settings.text: A little care keeps bedding soft and its colour fresh. These guides cover washing, drying and storing sheets, duvets and pillows.
settings.note: General guidance. This is general advice for caring for cotton, cotton satin and polyester fills. It is not specific to one product. Always follow the care label on your item first.

settings.heading: Bed sheets
settings.text: How to wash, dry, iron and store cotton, cotton satin and quilted cotton sheets and pillow covers so they stay soft and keep their colour. General guidance, plus the care given for our Quilted Bed Sheet Set.

settings.heading: Duvets and duvet covers
settings.text: Caring for a duvet filling and its cover: why the cover does most of the work, how to keep the filling lofty, when a filling can be washed, and how to dry and store it through the warm months.

settings.heading: Pillows
settings.text: Keeping filled pillows fresh: covers, airing and spot-cleaning, when a pillow can be washed, drying it completely, and the simple fold test that shows when a pillow needs replacing.

settings.heading: Care symbols explained
settings.text: The common laundry symbols you may find on a care label, and what each one means.

• Wash at the lowest temperature that gets things clean.
  • Use a mild detergent, and measure it: too much leaves fabric stiff.
  • Keep two sets of sheets and swap them, so each one rests between washes.
  • Treat stains straight away, before they dry.
  • Dry everything fully before you put it away.
